subject: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell: product page copy + procurement evidence
messages:
From: Suresh Patel <suresh@acmeops.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing & evidence checklist

Hi Rachel / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed by the latency numbers and the private deployment option. Procurement asked us to start with a short checklist so they can route this through legal and security earlier in the week. Can you share: 1) the current product page copy we will publish to AWS Marketplace, 2) the evidence binder (SOC2 / data retention / audit log samples) and 3) any standard procurement terms we recommend for quick review?

If possible, wed like to have the docs by EOD Thursday so we can set a procurement call for next week. Attaching the internal request they sent for context (they included a template).

Thanks,
Suresh
Head of Cloud Ops, AcmeOps

Attachment: procurement_request_template.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Suresh Patel <suresh@acmeops.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & evidence checklist

Hi Suresh — great to hear. Ive attached the latest product page copy were proposing for AWS Marketplace (short, benefit-led hero + three usage scenarios) and a redacted evidence pack we can share with procurement. Kimberly, looping you for pricing/footnote language and the standard procurement terms.

Quick plan:
- Attached: redwood-marketplace-copy-v2.docx (product page copy)
- Attached: ACME_Evidence_Request.pdf (redacted SOC2 summary + retention table + sample audit log)
- Next: Procurement call — can we do Tuesday 8/31 at 10am PT? Suresh, does that work for your team?

Action items for Kimberly: confirm recommended pricing footnote (metering clarity) and whether we can pre-provide a draft Private Offer template for their procurement team to speed review.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood-marketplace-copy-v2.docx, ACME_Evidence_Request.pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, Suresh Patel <suresh@acmeops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & evidence checklist

Thanks Rachel. Copy looks clean — a few high-level suggestions:

- Pricing footnote: call out per-1000-token billing and make explicit that dedicated instances (Reserved) are invoiced separately; suggest the short line: "Usage billed per 1K tokens; Dedicated capacity billed via reserved contract."
- Evidence: the redacted SOC2 summary is good for procurement; procurement may still request a sample retention policy with explicit timelines per data type (weve had that come up). Ill attach our standard Private Offer template and a short procurement FAQ that helps accelerate legal review.

Im available for the Tuesday 8/31 10am PT slot. Suresh — can you confirm procurement invite to include their legal lead? If so, Ill send the Private Offer draft ahead of time.

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood-privateoffer-template.docx, procurement-faq.pdf)

From: Suresh Patel <suresh@acmeops.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: AcmeOps Procurement <procurement@acmeops.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & evidence checklist

Perfect — thanks all. Tuesday 8/31 10am PT works; Ill include our legal (Maya Singh) and procurement lead (procurement@acmeops.com) on the invite. Please send the Private Offer template and the pricing footnote ahead of the call so we can circulate internally.

Two small asks from procurement after looking at your attachments: 1) can you add a one-line explanation on the product page about "data residency" options (we run in us-east and need to call out region support) and 2) a short bullet about retention defaults for customer-managed keys if we choose KMS. Not blockers but helps speed legal.

See you on Tuesday.

Suresh
Head of Cloud Ops, AcmeOps
(Referenced attachments: procurement_request_template.xlsx)
